entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mona, how much further do we have[n]until we reach the Treasure?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We might've gotten past a few traps...[n]but we're still at the start. We have[n]a long way to go.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know, I've been wonderin' about that...[n]How can you tell?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heheheh. Someone with my skills can[n]figure out the size of a building just from[n]its appearance.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The rest comes down to the distortion[n]and... I guess the Treasure's presence?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh. Either way, that sense has been[n]pretty spot on so far.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, we can prolly trust him when he[n]says we're still at the beginnin'. Let's get[n]movin'...
